verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a meta-skill, template, or spec for authoring and packaging a new skill. The listed skills cover TDD, grilling, triage, repo setup, writing specs for code changes, and choosing which skill to use. Editable installed files and the 'small, easy to adapt' framing are user-side adaptation of existing skills, not a documented skill-authoring workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can author and package a new skill end to end by following the project's own spec, template, or meta-skill
